<script>
const startTyping = () => {
  const rotator = document.querySelector(".home-rotator");
  const rotatorText = document.querySelector("#home-rotator-text");
  const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  const phrases = [
    "Soy Antropólogo",
    "Trabajo en procesamiento y análisis de datos",
    "Construyo flujos de trabajo reproducibles y trazables",
    "Exploro nuevas formas de investigar con modelos de lenguaje"
  ];

  if (!rotator || !rotatorText) return;

  if (reduceMotion) {
    rotatorText.textContent = phrases[0];
    return;
  }

  let phraseIndex = 0;
  let characterPosition = 0;
  let isDeleting = false;

  const typeNextCharacter = () => {
    const phrase = phrases[phraseIndex];

    if (isDeleting) {
      characterPosition -= 1;
      rotatorText.textContent = phrase.slice(0, characterPosition);

      if (characterPosition === 0) {
        phraseIndex = (phraseIndex + 1) % phrases.length;
        isDeleting = false;
        window.setTimeout(typeNextCharacter, 350);
        return;
      }

      window.setTimeout(typeNextCharacter, 28);
      return;
    }

    characterPosition += 1;
    rotatorText.textContent = phrase.slice(0, characterPosition);

    if (characterPosition === phrase.length) {
      isDeleting = true;
      window.setTimeout(typeNextCharacter, 2200);
      return;
    }

    window.setTimeout(typeNextCharacter, 45);
  };

  rotatorText.classList.add("is-typing");
  window.setTimeout(typeNextCharacter, 450);
};

if (document.readyState === "loading") {
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", startTyping);
} else {
  startTyping();
}
</script>
